prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for VOICES, a cozy top-down pixel-art RPG. Three-quarter front view of interior objects, consistent with detailed RPG Maker furniture. Crisp visible pixel clusters and warm dark outlines, readable silhouettes, restrained 3-5 tone shading, not photorealistic, no blur, no smooth 3D rendering. Elegant food heritage museum: deep emerald green, dark polished walnut, brushed antique brass and warm ivory stone. Refined, welcoming, sophisticated, not ostentatious. All objects complete and isolated within equal SQUARE grid cells, transparent gutters of at least 24 pixels, true transparent alpha background, no floor, no ground shadow, no people, no lettering, no numbers, no logos. No object may cross into a neighbouring cell. Keep every sign and plaque BLANK for live game typography. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen objects. Row 1: (1) a wide low museum glass display case, perfectly empty clear glass enclosure, thin brass corners and glass top, dark walnut enclosed plinth below, ivory display lining, front has a small blank green plaque; (2) a second low empty glass museum display case with pale ivory stone plinth, thin brass trim and a small blank green front plaque; (3) a taller narrow empty museum glass bell display case on emerald green and walnut pedestal, ivory lining; (4) an elegant open low walnut and brass museum pedestal with ivory stone top, empty. Row 2: (1) a refined reception desk, curved walnut front with emerald panels and thin brass borders, ivory counter and a small closed visitor book; (2) a low walnut museum archive cabinet, brass drawer handles; (3) an emerald upholstered museum bench, low walnut legs, no backrest; (4) a tall slim emerald and brass freestanding wayfinding directory, large blank flat sign. Row 3: (1) a lush compact indoor palm in an ivory stone planter; (2) two slender brass stanchions joined by a short emerald velvet rope; (3) a refined brass wall sconce with two ivory glass lamp shades, flat wall-mounted backplate, no wall; (4) an emerald and brass hanging pendant lamp with short chain, ivory warm underside. Row 4: (1) a landscape-format blank ivory museum wall panel, generous writing area, slim walnut border and brass corner details; (2) a very wide short blank emerald enamel nameplate in a slim brushed brass frame, clean straight rectangle; (3) a large wide blank emerald museum title panel, double thin brass border and modest ornamental corner details, no elaborate crest; (4) a complete pair of tall elegant walnut museum doors with brass handles, narrow glazed green upper panels, ivory stone door frame. No food in the cases: game overlays the collection.
